Glossary term: what is KV cache

One new definition on the local-AI shelf: the KV cache, the memory that decides how many sessions fit on one card. Page, pack, and this log entry land in the same change.

m
Machine Made WorldsSep 20, 2026 · 3 min read
In this article
MotivationWhat changedHow it was doneVerification evidence
Follow the journal ↗

The local-AI shelf gains a plain-English explainer on the KV cache, the reused past-token memory that caps how many sessions fit on one card. The new page renders at the KV cache explainer, a short pack carries the social copy with the canonical link, and this log entry ships beside both in the same change.

Motivation

Agent workloads keep multiplying live sessions per card, yet newcomers meeting slow long chats or crowded servers for the first time have no page that names the memory behind it. A glossary entry turns that repeated question into a page that teaches and interlinks, and the cited vendor example gives readers a current anchor without inventing numbers. This slot belongs to the cache that trades memory for speed on every token.

What changed

A new explainer now renders at the KV cache explainer: a one-line definition, a section on context length times sessions and agent-session density, a plain-English take on cache quantization with a link to the quantization entry, a cited-example section with vendor-reported labeling and stated limits, and a local-relevance closing on context settings with links to three existing guides. It is filed under the local-AI topic as kind Glossary with the featured flag untouched, and the builder appends the related-terms block automatically. A beside-each-article pack carries the short social copy with the canonical link.

How it was done

After the hosting preflight and a fresh branch from the main line, development drafted the term page from the established glossary pattern and added the pack plus this log entry in the same change. No template, style, or builder changes were needed: the existing article page supplies the eyebrow, lead, and related grid. The social copy was counted by hand against its limits before saving, and the cited example states no numbers of its own.

Verification evidence

The site build exits success, the full suite is green, and the presence gate prints success with this entry covering the change. The built glossary page shows the definition, the builder sections, and the auto-inserted related block, while the sitemap and feed include the new address. Every internal link resolves to an existing page, a scan of the diff finds no secrets, and security plus quality reviews attach to the exact pushed head after this pull request opens.
